catalyst.eligibility: Original 8-K only; exact timestamp required; eligible at a completed session close only if accepted by 21:00 UTC and within that close plus the prior four completed sessions. A known later Item 2.02 8-K/A invalidates the original event. Missing or ambiguous timestamps exclude the event.
catalyst.same_name_overlap: No pyramiding and no reset of the holding clock; an Item 2.02 amendment known after entry schedules an exit.

entry.signal_time: 21:00 UTC after each completed US session
entry.relative_strength: stock five-session close return > SPY five-session close return
entry.stock_trend: stock close > its 20-session simple moving average
entry.regime: SPY close > its 20-session simple moving average
entry.ranking: five-session stock return minus SPY return descending, then symbol and accession ascending
entry.cash_rule: Skip an entry if cash cannot fund the full 10% target including adverse cost; exits execute before entries at the same open; no same-open exit and re-entry in one symbol.

exit.trend_failure: stock close <= its 20-session SMA or SPY close <= its 20-session SMA
exit.amendment: any same-symbol Item 2.02 8-K/A accepted after entry and known by the close
exit.execution: next available common-session open with 2 bps adverse cost
exit.end_of_window: Mark open positions at the final close without hypothetical liquidation cost.

evaluation.holdout_rule: The 1 April 2026 boundary and all rules are fixed before outcomes; holdout starts with 100,000 USD cash and uses only prior-session information for its first signal.
evaluation.benchmark_universe_note: Previous strategies retain their existing SPY/QQQ/IWM universe and all-in single-position implementation; only the evaluation windows are changed.
evaluation.turnover: gross raw-open execution notional divided by average daily close equity
evaluation.exposure: daily close gross market value divided by daily close equity, averaged across evaluation sessions
evaluation.costs: sum of explicit 2 bps adverse execution adjustments on actual entries and exits; no cost on final mark-to-market
evaluation.trade_count: entries, with open and closed positions separately identified
evaluation.sharpe: Descriptive annualized arithmetic daily Sharpe at 0% risk-free only when at least 60 daily returns and nonzero volatility exist; no statistical significance claim with fewer than 30 closed trades.
evaluation.validation: One chronological development/holdout evaluation only. No optimization, no random-entry claim, and no Vibe walk-forward mislabelled as out-of-sample training. Bootstrap confidence intervals only if at least 30 closed trades; Monte Carlo trade-order permutation only as a path diagnostic.

limitations: Approximately 370 daily bars and sparse earnings events
Moomoo autype=1 forward ex-dividend-adjusted OHLC; not a total-return series
Common sessions and fractional shares; no borrow, tax, spread, market-impact or borrow modelling
SEC Item 2.02 is a deterministic earnings-filing proxy, not a semantic measure of every material company news event
Historical filings and adjusted prices are sourced now, so retrospective corrections by providers cannot be ruled out
execution_authorization: Research only. No order placement or automatic execution is enabled.
